description: The image displays two pie charts illustrating the breakdown of responses into four categories: Atomic Skill Fail (dark teal), Correct (medium teal), Reason Error (light teal), and Question Misunderstood (white), as defined by the legend above the charts. The left pie chart is divided into four segments: the largest segment, dark teal, represents Atomic Skill Fail at 68.0%; a medium teal segment labeled Correct at 12.0%; a light teal segment labeled Reason Error at 12.0%; and a white segment labeled Question Misunderstood at 8.0%. The right pie chart is also divided into four segments: the largest segment, medium teal, represents Question Misunderstood at 55.0%; a light teal segment labeled Reason Error at 21.0%; a white segment labeled Question Misunderstood at 14.0%; and a dark teal segment labeled Atomic Skill Fail at 10.0%. Both charts have percentage labels centered within their respective slices and are visually ordered with the largest segment at the bottom. The charts do not include exploded or offset segments, and the legend clearly maps each color to its corresponding category.
